ad_b_text: This is one of the most intense projects I’ve ever worked on — and probably one of the most personal.   For 20 days, I sculpted, photographed, composed, and animated to build a world that felt true to my characters. The hardest part wasn’t the technique. It was staying true to my universe while working within a structure that already existed. Finding the balance between what’s given… and what I need to say. This tutorial isn’t just a demo. It’s an invitation to look behind the image — at the hands, the tests, the doubts, and the desire to bring a small story to life, frame by frame. Adobe Firefly’s AI tools gave me access to technical possibilities I wouldn’t have had on my own — especially for animation. But it never dictated the message. It’s a tool — powerful, yes — but one that should serve the creative process, not replace it. When used with intention, it can amplify our ideas. But it’s still up to us to steer the ship.   A huge thank you to @adobefirefly for bringing me into this one-of-a-kind creative journey. It was a truly inspiring and meaningful opportunity. #adobepartner

ad_b_text: The Lil Mo Money Buff aka King Peacock Buffing Wheel from Renegade Products is a specially designed airway buffing wheel used in metal polishing, mainly for aluminum and stainless steel. Here’s what makes it unique: 	•	Material & Build: It’s constructed with a proprietary treated cloth that gives it more aggressiveness than a regular cotton buff, while still leaving a clean, smooth finish. 	•	Cut & Color: The King Peacock is considered a cut-and-color buffing wheel, meaning it has the strength to remove light scratches, oxidation, and sanding lines, while also beginning to bring out shine. 	•	Usage: Often paired with medium- to high-cut compounds (like Renegade’s Brown Tripoli or Wild Cherry), it’s a versatile wheel that can bridge the gap between heavy cutting buffs and softer coloring buffs. 	•	Application: Commonly used in truck polishing, automotive, and metal fabrication, especially on wheels, tanks, and stainless accessories. 	•	Performance: Known for running cooler and lasting longer than standard airway buffs, which helps reduce streaking and burning during polishing. 👉 Think of it as a “workhorse” buff that saves time by cutting and coloring in one step, before moving on to a high-shine finishing wheel.

ad_a_text: 📍 Amor 🔥 AMOR at Amoy Street — worth the hype or just atas vibes? Boujee but still justifiable (aka payday treat 😏). Spanish flavours, sexy plating, and every dish lowkey saying: “you deserve this.” We went all in!! 🐟 Tea Smoked King Salmon + Caviar Rich people starter energy 😭 Buttery, melts in your mouth, caviar pops with salty bursts. Balanced, indulgent… I almost checked my Toto app. 🍖 Iberico Pork Ribs Torch rosemary in front of you — aroma already wins. Super tender, juicy. Flavour leans lighter, more clean than bold. 🥩 Wagyu Short Ribs Soft, rich, with a slight sweetness. Balanced, comforting, easy to love. 🐟 Mediterranean Seabream Flaky, moist, clean flavours. Simple… but done right. 🥘 Seafood Paella Must order at any Spanish spot 😏 Rich seafood flavour, just wished for more crispy socarrat. 🥚 Happy Egggg Most atas egg ever 😂 Creamy, silky, comforting — lowkey addictive. 🌶 Padron Peppers Simple, light seasoning. Not my favourite, but easy to snack. 🍅 Pa Amb Tomaquet Fresh, light — perfect balance to cut the richness. 🧀 Jamón Iberico Croquettas THIS ONE 🔥 Crispy outside, creamy inside, full umami. Dangerous. 🍫 Pan con Chocolate Nice flame show 😅 Taste is more subtle — didn’t hit as hard for me. 🍰 Hazelnut Chocolate Lava Cake THE STAR 🤤 Break it — gooey lava flows out. Rich, nutty, indulgent. Must order. 🧀 Basque Cheesecake Creamy with slight bitterness… but lava cake stole the show 😂 💣 Bombas Crispy, savoury bites — great for sharing. 💭 Final Verdict Not everyday makan spot… but for a treat night? Worth it. Some hits, some misses — but overall vibe + experience = solid. 📍 107 Amoy Street, Singapore 🕒 Mon–Sat: 12PM–3PM | 6PM–12AM #AmorSG #AmoyStreet #SingaporeFood #SGFoodie #FoodgasmSG

Because babies start life primarily breathing through their nose, even tiny changes inside these very narrow nasal passages can make them sound dramatically congested. Things like: • Dry air • Crying • Milk reflux • Bathing • Small mucus buildup …can sometimes create congestion sounds that feel almost exactly like a cold, even when there isn’t actually an infection.
